split: Hold out entire host families. Keep all arms together. Report native-host and new-host results separately. Tier 3 hosts are now inspected development hosts. No detector fit or sealed-host access.
semantic: One original, one equivalent edit and one divergent edit per host. Exercise normal and triggering transactions at the source and after the common Yosys flow. Check directed outputs against independently specified expectations. Require both negative comparisons to be distinguishable in the typed view.
overlap: Per host and negative, sum absolute differences of gate-type counts divided by negative total gate count must be <=0.05. Report raw counts and size delta. Both negative comparisons must pass on every host.
controls: Fixed scalar scores: source characters, lines, CodeBERT windows, cell and edge counts, neutral-name fraction, comment fraction, normalized token count. Existing held-out linear controls: source metadata, histogram, graph stats, WL2/WL8, primary-input fanout, output XOR and cone equivalence. Report nonzero motif coverage.
origin: Within each label compare each generated family to all inspected TrustHub families equally; separately compare shared native-host derivatives within their own family. Frozen origin scores: characters, lines, windows, cells, neutral-name fraction, comment fraction, normalized token count. Normalization uses the same tokenizer for every source, removes comments, ignores whitespace and replaces user identifiers. Keep raw RTL for verification.
decision: Hard stop at paired win rate or origin AUROC >=0.90 in either direction on any tested control. Report descriptive host-resampled 95% intervals. Practical equivalence requires intervals within [0.30,0.70] for size/style/origin scores, at least six independent evaluation families, and coverage or explicit limitation for each motif. Unmet or unassessable conditions keep all rows development-only.
